comment: Whether a customer account is shared across all stores or kept separate per website.
modal: Sets account scope: **Global** lets a customer sign in on every website with one account; **Per Website** keeps accounts isolated, so the same email can register independently on each website.

comment: Whether new accounts are automatically placed in a customer group based on VAT ID validation.
modal: When **Yes**, new accounts are assigned to a customer group according to their VAT ID validation result, using the group settings below. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Which address — billing or shipping — is used to validate the VAT ID for group assignment.
modal: Chooses whether the **Billing Address** or **Shipping Address** drives VAT ID validation and tax calculation. Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The customer group assigned to newly created accounts.
modal: The default customer group new accounts are placed in, chosen from the store's configured customer groups. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The customer group assigned when a customer's VAT ID is valid and domestic.
modal: The group a customer is moved to when VAT ID validation returns a valid, domestic result. Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The customer group assigned when a customer's VAT ID is a valid intra-union (EU) number.
modal: The group a customer is moved to when VAT ID validation returns a valid intra-union result. Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The customer group assigned when a customer's VAT ID is invalid.
modal: The group a customer is moved to when VAT ID validation returns an invalid result. Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The customer group assigned when VAT ID validation cannot be completed.
modal: The group a customer is moved to when VAT ID validation fails to complete (for example a service error). Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether the customer's VAT ID is re-validated on every order rather than only at account creation.
modal: When **Yes**, the VAT ID is re-checked and the group re-evaluated on each transaction, not just when the account is created. Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The default value of each customer's flag that disables automatic VAT-based group changes.
modal: Sets the initial value of the per-customer **Disable Automatic Group Changes Based on VAT ID** flag. When **Yes**, VAT-based group reassignment is turned off by default for new customers.

comment: Which store email identity sends the new-account welcome email.
modal: Selects the sender identity for the welcome email — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2), set under *General → Store Email Addresses*. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether new customers must confirm their email address before the account becomes active.
modal: When **Yes**, newly registered customers receive a confirmation email and must verify their address before they can sign in. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether new accounts receive a human-friendly customer ID instead of the raw entity ID.
modal: When **Yes**, new customer accounts are assigned a human-friendly identifier rather than the internal sequential database ID.

comment: Which store email identity sends password reset and change emails.
modal: Selects the sender identity for password-reset emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether browsers may autocomplete the storefront login and forgot-password forms.
modal: When **Yes**, the login and forgot-password forms allow browser autocomplete of entered values. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether customers must re-confirm their email address after changing it.
modal: When **Yes**, a customer who changes their account email must confirm the new address before it takes effect. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether Date of Birth is hidden, optional, or required on registration and address forms.
modal: Controls the Date of Birth field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to the registration and address forms. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether the Tax/VAT Number is hidden, optional, or required on registration and address forms.
modal: Controls the Tax/VAT Number field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to the registration and address forms. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether Gender is hidden, optional, or required on registration and address forms.
modal: Controls the Gender field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to the registration and address forms. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether Telephone is hidden, optional, or required on address forms.
modal: Controls the Telephone field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to address forms. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether Company is hidden, optional, or required on address forms.
modal: Controls the Company field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to address forms. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether Fax is hidden, optional, or required on address forms.
modal: Controls the Fax field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to address forms. Can differ per website.

comment: The template that controls how addresses are formatted as plain text.
modal: The formatting template applied when an address is rendered as a text block. Edit the variables and layout to change how addresses appear. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The template that controls how an address is formatted on a single line.
modal: The formatting template applied when an address is rendered inline on one line. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The template that controls how addresses are formatted in generated PDF documents.
modal: The formatting template applied to addresses printed in PDF documents such as invoices and shipments. Can differ per website or store view.
